title: WARURU is out on Android. Place the same charges one floor lower and watch what happens.
author: dbdbdeep
selftext:
I made WARURU, a demolition sandbox named after the Korean sound of something tumbling down. One thing to try: plant two charges on one side of a building, set the second one to go off a little later, and hit the detonator. Then rebuild it and move the charges down a floor. The fun for me is guessing which way it'll fall and seeing where I was wrong. There's a suspension bridge to take apart, too.

One small piece of the Android release where I used generative AI was the launcher icon. I started with a reference of a wrecking ball hitting an orange building. At phone-icon size there wasn't room for all the little windows and bits of rubble. I asked the image editor for fewer, bigger pieces and a transparent background, with the impact near the center so the round Android mask wouldn't cut it off. I handled the padding and icon sizes separately.

[Play WARURU on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.echoplayroom.waruru)
